content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy is known for its user-friendly interface and the ability to sell digital products effortlessly, but this convenience comes with geographical restrictions that exclude many creators. Stripe and PayPal, while offering robust solutions, also impose limitations based on location. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to empower creators regardless of their geographic location, enabling them to fully control their online storefronts without relying on external payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms such as Stripe and PayPal often suspend accounts or restrict access to specific countries, leaving creators in those regions unable to monetize their work. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, creating a significant financial risk. Sovereign commerce solutions eliminate these risks by allowing creators to deploy independent digital commerce stacks that operate without the oversight of restrictive platforms. This ensures creators can consistently conduct business without the fear of arbitrary restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Transaction fees on platforms like Stripe and PayPal can be steep, especially for creators in regions with low transaction volumes. Additionally, payment processing delays can hinder cash flow. The Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which charges a mere 0.5% fee with no KYC requirements and facilitates instant on-chain payment verification. This results in faster payment processing and significantly lower fees, making it a financially sound choice for creators operating in restricted countries.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their platforms outright.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using traditional platforms, creators often find themselves at the mercy of third-party policies, risking their ownership of products and customer data. In contrast, with the sovereign commerce infrastructure provided by COREMERCH, creators maintain full ownership of their digital products and customer information after deployment. Automated delivery systems ensure that products are instantly delivered upon payment confirmation, eliminating the manual processes that can slow down sales.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the decision on which architecture to implement hinges on factors such as product type and expected sales volume. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal for creators looking to launch quickly with a fully tested solution, while the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is suitable for those who want a more basic setup. Evaluating individual needs against the capabilities of these stacks will guide creators in selecting the most effective infrastructure.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Say goodbye to arbitrary restrictions and account suspensions with independent stacks.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
